blockers: triton requires NVIDIA CUDA GPU (no AMD/Intel/CPU fallback)
triton kernels are compiled at first launch (slow cold-start)
triton.jit kernels cannot be directly translated to torch.compile without manual rewrite
D3Q19 lattice constants are hardcoded in triton kernels (not parameterised)

modules.name: _voxel_kernels
modules.function: STL voxelisation GPU kernels: ray-triangle parity for solid mask, Möller–Trumbore link-q for Bouzidi boundary fractions
modules.torch_alternative_reason: Ray-triangle intersection and Möller–Trumbore algorithm are inherently parallel and benefit from Triton's explicit memory control. A pure-torch version exists as fallback in geometry_voxel.py (solid_mask_parity_reference), but it is significantly slower for large meshes. torch.compile could accelerate it but would require rewriting the kernel logic into tensor operations (batched ray-triangle tests), which is non-trivial for the binned variants. The pure-torch reference path is already implemented and used as default when Triton is unavailable.

modules.name: triton_fused
modules.function: Fused D3Q19 LBM collide+stream kernel for periodic domains. Single kernel launch eliminates intermediate DRAM writes. Supports fp16/bf16 storage with fp32 compute.

output_shapes.triton_collide: (Q=19, nz, ny, nx) same dtype as input
output_shapes.triton_stream: (Q=19, nz, ny, nx) same dtype as input
output_shapes.triton_fused: (Q=19, nz, ny, nx) same dtype as input

modules.torch_alternative_reason: The fused collide+stream operation can be expressed as a sequence of torch operations: torch.roll for streaming + element-wise BGK collision. The existing perf_solver.OptimizedSolver3D already provides this as a pure-torch alternative. The triton version is 24x faster at n=256 but produces bit-identical results. torch.compile could narrow the gap but the memory-bound nature of LBM streaming means the fused kernel's advantage (eliminating intermediate DRAM writes) is fundamental. For correctness validation, the torch path is sufficient; for production performance, triton is preferred.

modules.name: triton_fused_obstacle
modules.function: Fused D3Q19 LBM step with bounce-back obstacles, LES Smagorinsky SGS, Ladd force reduction, and 6-face far-field BC. Production SUBOFF solver kernel.
modules.torch_alternative_reason: This module fuses 5 operations (collide, stream, bounce-back, force reduction, LES) into a single kernel. A pure-torch equivalent would require 5 separate kernel launches with intermediate DRAM writes, incurring significant memory bandwidth overhead. The bounce-back logic (per-cell conditional streaming) is particularly expensive in torch because it requires masked scatter/gather operations. The force reduction (atomic add over wall cells) has no direct torch equivalent. However, the perf_solver.OptimizedSolver3D provides a functional torch alternative for the collide+stream portion, and boundary conditions can be applied separately. For production SUBOFF runs, the triton version is essential for performance.

modules.name: triton_fused_distributed
modules.function: Multi-GPU slab decomposition with NCCL halo exchange for Triton fused D3Q19. Wraps triton_fused.triton_fused with selective halo exchange (5 of 19 directions per face for D3Q19).
modules.torch_alternative_reason: This module is a wrapper around triton_fused.triton_fused with NCCL communication. The halo exchange logic (selective direction transfer, async NCCL) is pure torch.distributed and does not use triton directly. The underlying triton_fused call can be replaced with torch.roll + BGK collision (as in perf_solver). The distributed logic (slab decomposition, halo exchange) is framework-agnostic and works with any step implementation. The module already has a fallback path via the underlying triton_fused.is_available() check.

modules.name: triton_backend
modules.function: Backend wrapper for Triton-fused SUBOFF step. Provides triton_suboff_step() as the step implementation for the SUBOFF production runner when use_triton_step=True. Manages persistent buffers (ping-pong, force, tau_eff).

output_shapes.triton_suboff_step: (f_new, fx, fy, fz) — f_new: (Q=19, nz, ny, nx) fp32, forces: scalar tensors

modules.torch_alternative_reason: This module is a thin wrapper that calls triton_fused_obstacle_xfar_les and applies BC/mass correction in torch. The torch_backend module provides an equivalent pure-torch step implementation. The backend interface is designed to be swappable: the same runner can use either triton_backend or torch_backend depending on availability. The persistent buffer management (TritonStepState) has a direct torch equivalent in the torch_backend's state management.
